flowchart LR %% Fictional CRM service rollout; status date 2026-10-14. %% Edges mean deliverable containment, not task dependencies or reporting lines. %% Every leaf states an acceptance condition; none claims completion. P["1.0 Customer service rollout
3 service desks · 40 users · 20,000 records"]:::anchor subgraph G1["1.1 Business and acceptance baseline"] WP111["1.1.1 Agreed business flows
Evidence: normal, exception and delegate
paths signed off by the Business Lead"]:::normal WP112["1.1.2 Access and SLA specification
Evidence: 4 access roles and notification
deadlines agreed with named approvers"]:::normal WP113["1.1.3 Acceptance scenario set
Evidence: pass/fail criteria agreed
for all 30 mandatory cases"]:::normal end subgraph G2["1.2 First-release business functions"] WP121["1.2.1 Intake and assignment
Evidence: replayed submissions create
zero duplicate registrations"]:::normal WP122["1.2.2 Service and approval history
Evidence: each change identifies
who changed what, when and why"]:::normal WP123["1.2.3 SLA notices and reporting
Evidence: in-app and email outputs reconcile;
SMS stays outside the approved scope"]:::normal end subgraph G3["1.3 Data migration and CRM integration"] WP131["1.3.1 Migration data and mapping
Evidence: all 20,000 source records trace
to a target or an approved exclusion"]:::normal WP132["1.3.2 CRM integration and replay control
Evidence: real-endpoint authentication,
retry and concurrency cases verified"]:::normal WP133["1.3.3 Migration decision record
Evidence: decisions for all 80 duplicate-key
candidates applied and differences rechecked"]:::normal end subgraph G4["1.4 Independent quality and safety evidence"] WP141["1.4.1 Integration and acceptance results
Evidence: all 30 mandatory cases pass;
zero unresolved major defects"]:::normal WP142["1.4.2 Access and data protection evidence
Evidence: production permissions and
personal-data conditions approved"]:::normal WP143["1.4.3 Performance and recovery results
Evidence: agreed load, batch-window and
restore conditions demonstrated in tests"]:::normal end subgraph G5["1.5 Operations and adoption"] WP151["1.5.1 Operations and rollback runbook
Evidence: stop conditions, restore checks
and business restart rehearsed"]:::normal WP152["1.5.2 Night batch and monitoring design
Evidence: low-usage window, overrun stop
and controlled rerun verified"]:::normal WP153["1.5.3 Training and handover record
Evidence: primary/backup contacts, user
training and open-item acceptance recorded"]:::normal end subgraph G6["1.6 Project governance"] WP161["1.6.1 Charter and decision rights
Evidence: exclusions, approval authority
and change procedure acknowledged"]:::normal WP162["1.6.2 Baseline and change history
Evidence: effort, cost and dates traceable
before and after each authorized change"]:::normal WP163["1.6.3 Issue, risk and decision records
Evidence: owner, due date, decision and
closure proof recorded for every open item"]:::normal end P --- G1 P --- G2 P --- G3 P --- G4 P --- G5 P --- G6

sources.workflow:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant Biz as Business participant PM as PM participant Dev as Development participant Ops as Operations participant Info as Info Mgmt participant QA as Quality participant Sponsor as Sponsor Note over Biz,Sponsor: CR-01 / ISSUE-03 / RISK-04 — fictional, as of 2026-10-14. Decisions pending 2026-10-16.
Request evidence: purpose, recipients and acceptance criteria. Baseline: in-app/email only, SMS excluded.
Provisional estimate: +8 person-days / +JPY 600,000. Biz->>PM: Request first-release SMS alt Request lacks evidence PM-->>Biz: Return for missing evidence else Assess the change without authorizing implementation Note over PM,QA: PM commissions parallel impact assessment. par Effort and delivery Dev-->>PM: Effort, date impact and alternatives and Personal data and external transmission Info-->>PM: Required evidence, safety blockers and owners and Operations Ops-->>PM: Operational constraints and handover checks and Independent validation QA-->>PM: Mandatory coverage and independent real-endpoint evidence end alt Information-management release conditions remain unmet Info-->>PM: Block release of the proposed change until specified evidence is accepted Note over PM,Sponsor: Sponsor cannot waive safety blockers. Keep the current baseline and CR-01 open. else Evidence permits Sponsor review PM->>Sponsor: Compare approval, deferral and rejection with cost, dates and residual risks alt Reject the request Sponsor-->>PM: Reject with reasons and reconsideration conditions else Defer SMS beyond the first release Sponsor-->>PM: Defer with an owner, next review date and required evidence or resources else Approve with explicit scope, funding and conditions Sponsor-->>PM: Conditionally approve only the recorded scope, cost and conditions Note over PM,Sponsor: Conditional approval alone does not activate a changed baseline alt Conditions or resources are still missing PM-->>Biz: Hold implementation, resolve conditions/resources else Conditions and resources are confirmed PM->>Dev: Version the baseline and authorize work Dev->>QA: Submit implementation and real-endpoint regression evidence Note over PM,QA: Failure or business return reopens linked work.
Retest and acceptance must pass. alt Verification fails, evidence is incomplete or escalation is required QA-->>Dev: Return defects, keep release blocked Note over PM,Sponsor: CR-01 remains open, escalation is not acceptance or release authority else Independent verification passes and blockers are cleared QA-->>Biz: Present independent results against the agreed criteria alt Business returns Biz-->>PM: Return unaccepted criteria else Business accepts Biz-->>PM: Accept with evidence PM->>PM: Close CR-01 with evidence end end end end opt Rejection or deferral PM-->>Biz: Notify decision and next review end end end

gantt
  title CRM service rollout — integrated schedule, fictional, as of 2026-10-14
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  axisFormat %m/%d
  tickInterval 1week
  todayMarker off
  accTitle: Six trial baseline/actual-or-forecast pairs and a complete implementation proposal
  accDescr: Status date 2026-10-14. Only requirements and trial access have actual completion records. API 401, 80 duplicate-key candidates and a 3-person-day capacity gap remain unresolved. The 30 implementation entries are an unapproved proposal; decision markers are planned reviews, not approvals. Replan and seek reapproval if prerequisites fail.
  %% taskobo-gantt-status {"schema":"taskobo.gantt-status/v1","calendar":"calendar-days","asOf":"2026-10-14","statusMarker":"status_date","items":[{"baseline":"b_requirements","current":"a_requirements","baselineEnd":"2026-10-08","finish":"2026-10-10","stage":"done"},{"baseline":"b_api","current":"f_api","baselineEnd":"2026-10-12","finish":"2026-10-18","stage":"forecast"},{"baseline":"b_migration","current":"f_migration","baselineEnd":"2026-10-20","finish":"2026-10-23","stage":"forecast"},{"baseline":"b_test","current":"f_test","baselineEnd":"2026-10-26","finish":"2026-10-26","stage":"forecast","risk":true},{"baseline":"b_training","current":"f_training","baselineEnd":"2026-10-23","finish":"2026-10-22","stage":"forecast"},{"baseline":"b_access","current":"a_access","baselineEnd":"2026-10-11","finish":"2026-10-11","stage":"done"}],"plannedTasks":["vendor_reply","decision_oct16","night_contacts","trial_gate","p_biz","p_scope","p_perm","p_plan","p_baseline","p_ui","p_intake","p_history","p_sla","p_feature","p_clean","p_api","p_migration","p_rehearsal","p_env","p_monitor","p_threat","p_security","p_integration","p_performance","p_uat","p_retest","p_accepted","p_training","p_runbook","p_dress","p_go","p_release","p_support","p_finish"]}
  %% All durations are calendar days, including weekends; they are not effort or percent complete.
  %% Baseline: hollow dashed; actual: solid; forecast: dashed; implementation proposal: pale dashed.
  %% Proposal dates preserve the original dependency calculation; trial delay impacts are not yet reapproved.
  section Fixed status date
  Status date 2026-10-14 :milestone, status_date, 2026-10-14, 0d
  section Trial — requirements agreement

  Actual finish 10/10 / 2 days late :done, a_requirements, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-10
  section Trial — CRM connection / ISSUE-01

  section Trial — migration / ISSUE-02

  Forecast 10/23 / 3 days later than baseline :active, f_migration, 2026-10-09, 2026-10-23
  section Trial — integration testing / ISSUE-04 and ISSUE-06
  Baseline finish 10/26 :b_test, 2026-10-14, 2026-10-26

  section Trial — key-user training
  Baseline finish 10/23 :b_training, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-23
